name: Lord Morvane

passive.name: Crown of Ash
passive.text: Whenever one of his allies dies (not a summon), Morvane gains a shield of 10% of his max HP for 3 turns. Shields stack.

boss.where: rules Castle Morvane at the end of the campaign
notes: Warnings: Ashfall and the Pyre of Morvane do not hit at once. The marked cells smoulder and the attack lands at the start of Morvane's next turn, before he acts. Every hero gets at least one turn in between. These hits cannot miss.
Ashfall marks a block of cells: move out of it (Move). From phase 2 the block is wider.
The Pyre of Morvane marks your whole side and has no safe cell: shield, guard, fortify or heal your heroes before it lands.

passives.name: Crown of Ash
passives.text: Whenever one of his allies dies (not a summon), Morvane gains a shield of 10% of his max HP for 3 turns. Shields stack: killing his guards first makes him harder to burn.

passives.name: Burning Crown
passives.text: At 60% HP the crown burns: Ashfall grows to 2x3. At 30% Valdoria burns with him: he acts twice a turn, hits 15% harder and at once calls the Pyre of Morvane. A single attack can cross only one of these thresholds.
